title: Alert Operations Center
description: Investigation urgency. Data quality and pipeline health remain separate from market structure.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND status != 'resolved'

SELECT count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND status != 'resolved' AND severity IN ('critical','high')

SELECT count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND status = 'resolved'

SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, severity, status, alert_type, summary FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND 1 ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, severity, status, alert_type, summary FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND category = 'DATA_QUALITY' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, severity, status, alert_type, summary FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND category = 'PIPELINE_HEALTH' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT updated_at, alert_id, revision, severity, status, summary FROM market_alerts FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic AND ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 300

SELECT category, count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') GROUP BY category

SELECT alert_type, count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') GROUP BY alert_type

SELECT severity, count() AS alerts FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') GROUP BY severity

SELECT avgOrNull(dateDiff('second', first_detected_at, resolved_at)) AS duration FROM (SELECT updated_at, canonical_pair, category, alert_type, severity, status, summary, first_detected_at, resolved_at, alert_id, revision, integrity_score, integrity_score_change FROM market_alerts WHERE NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic ORDER BY revision DESC, updated_at DESC LIMIT 1 BY alert_id) WHERE ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND status = 'resolved' AND $__timeFilter(resolved_at)

SELECT updated_at, integrity_score, integrity_score_change, severity, status FROM market_alerts FINAL WHERE $__timeFilter(updated_at) AND NOT is_replay AND NOT is_synthetic AND ('${canonical_pair}' = 'all' OR canonical_pair = '${canonical_pair}') AND ('${category}' = 'all' OR category = '${category}') AND ('${severity}' = 'all' OR severity = '${severity}') AND ('${status}' = 'all' OR status = '${status}') AND ('${alert_type}' = 'all' OR alert_type = '${alert_type}') AND alert_type = 'integrity_deterioration' ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 100
